region.value: KSA — Hijazi register (Jeddah / Riyadh street-food culture)

tone_register.value: warm-conversational — neighbourhood eatery energy, familiar and welcoming

quality_tier.value: universal — accessible everyday price point, aspirationally crafted

modesty_register.value: STRICT (Saudi default — no skin, no mixed-gender intimacy, conservative dress in frame)

primary.value: Warm saffron ochre (~#C9472B brick-red) as the primary brand colour; deep amber (~#8B5E1A) as the coffee accent; clean cream (~#F5EDD8) as the neutral ground. Inspired by karak tea's toffee colour and shawarma's char marks.

background_tone.value: Warm natural daylight or golden late-afternoon light. Surfaces: worn timber café tables, woven palm-leaf place mats, terracotta tile floors. NEVER cool/blue-tinted studio light. Shadows are warm and soft.

color_field_palette.value: Three brand fields: (1) brick-red/terracotta (~#C9472B) — the brand mark field; (2) deep amber/toffee (~#8B5E1A) — coffee, warmth, depth; (3) cream/linen (~#F5EDD8) — clean neutral, food surfaces. EXCLUDE: blue, cold greys, electric green.

capture_character.value: Street-level documentary warmth. Overhead and three-quarter food shots; hand-held candid energy for café moments. Visible condensation on cold drinks; rising steam on hot ones. Real surfaces (timber, stone, woven mat). No artificial props, no floating ingredients, no geometric food towers.

style_descriptor.value: Warm, appetite-forward food photography with a neighbourhood-café feel: real steam and condensation, golden-hour light, textured surfaces. Saudi street food in its honest serving form — khobz, paper cups, foil trays.

lighting.value: Warm natural daylight or late-afternoon golden hour for hero food shots. Tungsten-warm indoors for café atmosphere. No harsh direct flash, no cool blue-white studio light.

caption_style.value: short_warm — colloquial Hijazi Arabic, max 160 chars, conversational opener, one idea per caption

sub_sector.value: Food & Beverage — Casual Dining + Specialty Coffee

humor_tolerance.value: minimal — warm-playful only; NO sarcasm, NO edgy references

anti_attributes.value: No cartoon/illustration. No oversaturation. No CGI plastic food. No cold lighting. No bedrooms. No clothing removal. No mixed-gender intimacy. No sports bodies. No alcohol props.
